title: DIR-071: Recruiter Applicant ATS Pipeline Word/PDF Export Fix & Global Candidate Photo Visibility Toggle Enforcement
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. RECRUITER ATS PIPELINE DOCX/PDF EXPORT: In src/components/EmployerPortal/EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx, change withAuth: false to withAuth: true, and robustly pass jobId (jobId or job_id) and applicationId. 2. OPTIONAL AUTH MIDDLEWARE FOR PUBLIC EXPORT ROUTES: In backend/security/auth.js, export optionalAuth middleware that decodes Bearer token when present without rejecting when absent. In backend/index.js, ensure optionalAuth runs on publicApiPaths so req.user is populated when a recruiter Bearer token is provided. 3. EMPLOYER CLAIM ON PUBLIC-EXPORT (PDF & DOCX): In backend/index.js /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx, verify the employer claim when jobId and applicationId are provided and req.user owns the job. When verified, export candidate's actual applied resume from repo.getResume(applicantId, resumeId) instead of failing 404 or reading stale public_resumes. 4. GLOBAL PHOTO VISIBILITY SUPPRESSION: When showPhoto is false (or hidePhoto: true / includePhoto: false), photo MUST be null. Enforce in: (A) src/cv-templates/templateUtils.js line 104, (B) src/utils/resumeData.js normalizeResumeData, (C) backend/repositories/MySQLRepository.js _resumeSnapshot, (D) src/components/BuildResume/BuildResume.jsx pass persistLatest to downloadResumePdf. 5. REGRESSION & SECURITY GUARDS: Zero IDOR (an employer can only export their own job applicants), src/cv-templates remains git diff 0, tests/dir071-recruiter-export-photo-toggle.test.mjs created and passing.

plan.summary: DIR-071 P0, reconnaissance complete with every finding cited to file:line. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: XAMPP-only servers (no detached node/vite/nodemon), zero IDOR on the public export routes, the frozen 55 template modules stay untouched, and the DIR-063..070 suites plus the census and xampp-policy gates stay green. ROOT CAUSE OF THE RECRUITER EXPORT FAILURE: optionalAuth does not exist anywhere in the repository (a repo-wide grep matches only this directive spec). backend/index.js:465 short-circuits public paths with if (isPublicApiPath(req.path)) return next();, so req.user is NEVER populated on /api/public-export or /api/public-export-docx. The employer-claim branch I added in DIR-069 (index.js:4448 if (req.user?.uid) is therefore DEAD CODE that can never fire, and the PDF route (index.js:2441) has no claim branch at all - it goes straight to repo.getPublicResume and 404s an unpublished draft. That is the real defect, and the client-side withAuth:false at EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx:317 is its mirror. (1) OPTIONAL AUTH MIDDLEWARE: in backend/security/auth.js I will extract the inline Bearer parsing (auth.js:115-117) into a shared helper and export optionalAuth(req,res,next) that decodes a present Bearer token into the SAME frozen req.user shape requireAuth builds, and calls next() when the header is absent or the token is invalid - it never 401s, so the public routes stay genuinely public. (2) WIRING: the /api public-path branch in backend/index.js will await optionalAuth before next(), so a recruiter Bearer token populates req.user on the public export routes. (3) EMPLOYER CLAIM ON BOTH ROUTES: I will extract the DIR-069 verification into ONE shared helper (require req.user.uid; repo.getJob(jobId).employerId === req.user.uid; the application must belong to that job AND reference exactly this resumeId) and call it from BOTH /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx, so the two cannot drift. When verified the route exports the candidate's ACTUAL applied resume via repo.getResume(applicantId, resumeId) instead of 404ing or reading a stale public_resumes row; otherwise the strict published-only rule (isPublished true, publicationMode explicit) is unchanged. Zero IDOR: the employer id, the job id, the application id and the resume id must all agree server-side, and no client value is trusted as authority. (4) CLIENT: EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx moves to withAuth:true and passes jobId from jobId ?? job_id and applicationId from applicationId ?? application_id ?? id, keeping the existing per-button loading state and the role=status error line. UX STATES: the drawer keeps its loading, busy and error surfaces; the fix removes a dead-end 404, and no new spinner or empty state is introduced. (5) GLOBAL PHOTO VISIBILITY SUPPRESSION: photo MUST be null whenever showPhoto is false (or hidePhoto true / includePhoto false). Confirmed gaps: (A) src/cv-templates/templateUtils.js:104 nulls only non-strings, never consulting showPhoto; (B) src/utils/resumeData.js:104-105 computes showPhoto but leaves photo intact; (C) MySQLRepository._resumeSnapshot:163-171 coerces showPhoto to a boolean but never nulls photo, so a hidden photo still ships in the public snapshot; (D) src/components/BuildResume/BuildResume.jsx:1142 exports the PDF after persistLatest({manual:true}) at 1133 without the visibility flag being authoritative. I will null the photo at every one of those four boundaries. SUPERSEDED CONTRACT FLAGGED HONESTLY: mandate 4A edits src/cv-templates/templateUtils.js while mandate 5 requires src/cv-templates to stay git diff 0 - those cannot both hold as written. templateUtils.js is the SHARED utility, not one of the 55 frozen template modules (cv1..cv51, cover1..cover4), so I will make the edit and re-scope the DIR-068 seal assertion to freeze the 55 template DIRECTORIES, reporting this supersession explicitly rather than silently weakening the seal. ACCESSIBILITY: no control is added or removed; the existing aria-labels, keyboard reachability and the at-or-above 4.5:1 contrast of the export buttons are unchanged. SECURITY: no token is ever logged, the Bearer value is never echoed to the client, error payloads keep the existing requestId contract with no plaintext secret leakage, and the new optionalAuth path cannot elevate a request because it only ever sets req.user and never grants a permission. PERFORMANCE: optionalAuth adds at most one verifyIdToken call on a request that already carries a Bearer token, public requests without one pay nothing, and the sub-4.0s build and sub-100ms render budgets are untouched. QA: a new tests/dir071-recruiter-export-photo-toggle.test.mjs with static contracts plus functional proofs that the claim rejects a foreign employer, a mismatched resumeId and a mismatched jobId, that the published-only fallback still 404s, and that photo is null under every visibility flag combination.
steps: 1. backend/security/auth.js: extract the inline Bearer regex from requireAuth into a shared tokenFromHeader helper and export a new optionalAuth middleware that decodes a present Bearer token into the same frozen req.user shape and always calls next(), never 401ing
2. backend/index.js: make the /api public-path branch await optionalAuth before next() so req.user is populated on public routes when a recruiter Bearer token is supplied

3. backend/index.js: extract the DIR-069 employer-claim verification into one shared helper that requires req.user.uid, checks repo.getJob(jobId).employerId === req.user.uid, and requires the application to belong to that job and reference exactly this resumeId

4. backend/index.js: call that helper from BOTH /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx so the PDF route gains the claim it never had and the DOCX claim stops being dead code, exporting repo.getResume(applicantId, resumeId) when verified and keeping the strict published-only 404 fallback otherwise

5. src/components/EmployerPortal/EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx: switch withAuth false to true and pass jobId from jobId ?? job_id and applicationId from applicationId ?? application_id ?? id, keeping the existing loading and role=status error surfaces
6. src/cv-templates/templateUtils.js: null the photo whenever showPhoto is false, hidePhoto is true or includePhoto is false
7. src/utils/resumeData.js: enforce the same rule inside normalizeResumeData so photo is null whenever the resolved showPhoto is false
8. backend/repositories/MySQLRepository.js: enforce the same rule in _resumeSnapshot so a hidden photo can never reach a public publication snapshot
9. src/components/BuildResume/BuildResume.jsx: make the photo-visibility flag authoritative on the PDF and DOCX export path so a hidden photo is never exported

10. tests/dir071-recruiter-export-photo-toggle.test.mjs: static contracts (optionalAuth exported and wired, withAuth true, the shared claim helper used by both routes, the four photo boundaries) plus functional proofs (a foreign employer, a mismatched resumeId and a mismatched jobId are all rejected, the published-only fallback still 404s, and photo is null for every visibility flag combination)
11. re-scope the DIR-068 seal assertion to the 55 frozen template directories and report the templateUtils.js supersession explicitly

12. evidence: run npm run lint, test:security, test:product, test:templates, the DIR-063..071 suites, the census and xampp-policy gates and npm run build (verify sub-4.0s), confirm the 55 template dirs are unchanged, then submit via bridge dev submit-evidence.
